agency_catalog_policy.name: agency_catalog_policy
agency_catalog_policy.using:
((client_id IS NULL) OR (client_id = ( SELECT agency_db_users.client_id
   FROM agency_db_users
  WHERE (agency_db_users.db_username = CURRENT_USER))))

public.dominic_live_catalog.name: dominic_live_catalog
public.dominic_live_catalog.definition: SELECT d.id AS domain_id, d.w AS domain, min(p.price::double precision) AS price, TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(max(p.currency), 'EUR'::bpchar)) AS currency, m."domainRating"::double precision AS dr, m."orgTraffic" AS monthly_traffic, d.category AS niche_category, d.country FROM lp_marketplace_domains d JOIN lp_domain_price p ON p."domainId" = d.id LEFT JOIN lp_domain_metrics m ON m."domainId" = d.id WHERE d."isActive" = true AND p."isActive" = true AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.w, m."domainRating", m."orgTraffic", d.category, d.country

public.adaptify_guest_post_offers.name: adaptify_guest_post_offers
public.adaptify_guest_post_offers.definition: SELECT concat('lp_', d.id::text) AS offer_id, d.w AS domain, true AS orderable, true AS is_guest_post, 'guest_post'::text AS placement_type, min(p.price::numeric) AS price, TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(max(p.currency), 'EUR'::bpchar)) AS currency, m."domainRating"::numeric AS dr, m."orgTraffic" AS monthly_traffic, d.category AS niche, d.language, d.country AS country_code, 14 AS turnaround_days, true AS accepts_client_article, true AS will_write_article, 1 AS max_links, max(p."updatedAt") AS last_verified_at FROM lp_marketplace_domains d JOIN lp_domain_price p ON p."domainId" = d.id LEFT JOIN lp_domain_metrics m ON m."domainId" = d.id WHERE d."isActive" = true AND p."isActive" = true AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.w, m."domainRating", m."orgTraffic", d.category, d.language, d.country
